question: Do they report results only on English data?
title: Towards a Continuous Knowledge Learning Engine for Chatbots
answer_rationale: The documents mention that LiLi is evaluated on two standard real-world KBs: Freebase and WordNet, which are not exclusively English datasets. Freebase is described as having a higher number of unknown test relations, and WordNet is also referenced as a dataset used for evaluation, indicating that results are not limited to English data.
